title: Verify: Radix dialog open, Escape and focus behavior unit tests
summary: Unit tests for dialog semantics and keyboard/focus
description: Test the Radix dialog shell with fetch mocked.
acceptance_criteria: Focus enters dialog and returns to trigger
technical_constraints: jsdom, vitest, fetch stubbed with vi.stubGlobal

steps.action: Create the test file with `// @vitest-environment jsdom`. Stub fetch to return the JSON of an empty array (history route mirrors listMine in src/api/client.ts; payload entries come from contributionFixture in tests/fixtures/api.ts, mirroring contributionJSON in backend/internal/contribution/handler.go). Test 'exposes a named dialog': render a harness with a trigger button that toggles ContributionSheet open; click it; assert screen.getByRole('dialog', {name: 'Suggest What Happens Next'}) is present and window.location.pathname is unchanged.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionDialog.test.tsx -t "named dialog"

steps.action: With the harness open and onClose a vi.fn, fire keyDown Escape on the dialog; assert onClose called once.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionDialog.test.tsx -t "escape"

steps.action: Focus the trigger, click it, assert document.activeElement is inside the dialog (dialog.contains), then close via the Close button and assert document.activeElement is the trigger button (await waitFor).
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionDialog.test.tsx -t "focus"
steps.expected: Focus enters dialog and returns to trigger
